_readme: Dates on which the VIIRS SNPP archive is defective. A date listed here
must be excluded from BOTH sides of any comparison, never summed as a
zero: a day the instrument did not observe is not a day without fire.
Two classes, found by two different sweeps, because a check on VALUES
is structurally unable to see a MISSING RECORD.
thin    present but far below its own neighbourhood. Found by
comparing roster-wide daily totals against a local median.
absent  no record at all, inside a year the builder marked complete,
so it was being read as zero. Found by set-difference against
the calendar.
Confirmed against VIIRS NOAA-20, an independent platform: five sampled
thin days read 0.00 to 0.06 of NOAA-20 while two controls read 0.92 and
0.99. 2022-08-01 is still zero in science-quality four years on, so
these do not heal.
Effect if summed as zero: the baseline mean falls and every multiple
computed against it INFLATES, in the direction that flatters our own
headlines. Mean 0.5% per weekly window, worst 6.6% for the window
beginning 9 July.
Swept 2026-08-05. 2024 holds 19 absent and 7 thin days; a year that
defective still passes the 300-day completeness threshold.
